summary: TI Investors of Lakeview Nitto Parcel LLC is building a 152,334 sf speculative industrial building: 91 parking spaces (4 ADA), 15 trailer stalls, 2 drive-in doors and 16 docks on the south side. Access is two driveways on 108th Street; none on STH 31. The Plan Commission approved the site and operational plans on 8/17/26 with 21 conditions.
